A historic hotel in midtown Manhattan, located 1585 feet from Central Park, Warwick New York offers 2 restaurants, a fitness center and concierge services. Express check-out services are also available. All accommodations feature marble bathrooms, desks with international plug-ins, flat-screen TVs and fully stocked mini-bar. Mural’s on 54th, the onsite restaurant, was named after Dean Cornwell who painted the murals on the walls of the restaurant. The Warwick is also home to Randolph’s Bar and Lounge. The Museum of Modern Art is 531 feet away while Fifth Avenue and Radio City Music Hall are 1148 feet from the property. Rockefeller Center is 1585 feet from the property.

Couples in particular like the location – they rated it 9.6 for a two-person trip.
